notes: Sheets are stored as base64 chunks following the repo convention: sheets/<file>.b64.000, .001, ... Restore with: cat sheets/<file>.b64.* | base64 -d > <file>, then verify SHA-256 against this manifest.
The 50 cut poses produced by the episode's split_sheets.py (art/poses/, local-only at audit time) are not included; the sheets are the source art from which poses are cut.
Source figures are about 600 px tall in the episode's cut poses (ART_AUDIT.md), so close-ups will be soft; the sheets themselves are 1122-1672 px on their long edge.
